subject: SIG control crosswalk — Q2 artifacts & evidence cadence for QuantumPay
messages:

Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@quantumpay.com>
Date: 2027-02-21T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire and evidence timing

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the demo last week — QuantumPay is moving toward an internal vendor risk review and we need to complete the SIG questionnaire and collect supporting artifacts. Attached is our SIG 1.1 workbook (we removed the previous version). Can you confirm:

- Who at Redwood will own the SIG responses?
- Rough ETA for a completed control crosswalk and initial artifact packet?
- Preferred method for receiving sensitive documents (SFTP, secure Drive link, or portal)?

We have a procurement review starting the week of March 1 and a security review team available for a walkthrough the week after. Can you share an outline of deliverables and dates you can commit to?

Thanks,
Sanjay
Director, Risk & Compliance
QuantumPay

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire and evidence timing

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the note and the workbook. We can own the SIG responses and will provide a control crosswalk and an initial evidence pack ahead of your procurement review. High-level proposed cadence: 

1) By 2027-02-24: control crosswalk draft (mapping SIG sections to our SOC 2 & ISO artifacts) — attachment: control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx
2) By 2027-02-26: initial evidence packet (SOC2 report, sample policy docs, audit logs summary) — attachment: redwood_SOC2-report-2026Q4.pdf (stub)
3) Week of 2027-03-08: 45-minute technical walkthrough with our security engineering team (can do 2x slots; propose Tue/Wed)

For sensitive uploads we prefer a client-specific secure Drive folder with restricted access; we can also provide SFTP if you require. For now, please share the procurement contact (email) and any specific evidence items you need beyond the standard SIG ask.

I'll loop in Marissa (security) and Karthik (solutions) to finalize the artifact list and confirm the walkthrough slots.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SIG control crosswalk & artifact cadence (QuantumPay)

Thanks Neha — I ran a quick pass on the crosswalk and sketched an evidence matrix. Key notes: 

- SOC 2 report (2026 Q4) covers most SIG sections related to logical access, change mgmt, and incident response. Will attach a redacted PDF for sharing.
- ISO 27001 evidence: we have the certificate and select policy bundles; certificate can be shared publicly, policies are internal (we will provide redacted copies).
- Logs & ephemeral artifacts: we can provide summarized retention/export of audit logs and a sample slice (7 days) for service-account actions. Full raw logs require a secure transfer and NDA addendum — flagging for commercial/Legal.
- Controls flagged as 'variant' in the SIG (e.g., vendor subprocessing details) will need short narrative responses rather than artifacts. I'll draft those.

ETA: control_crosswalk_v2 + redacted SOC2 by 2027-02-24 EOD; full initial packet by 2027-02-26 pending Legal sign-off on any sensitive transfer.

Attachments (to upload to shared folder): redwood_SOC2-report-2026Q4.pdf (redacted stub), control_crosswalk_v2_notes.docx (notes stub)

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Manager, Redwood Inference
